featured_reviews.name: Prashanta Bagchi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ENTHUSIASTICALLY recommend Dr. Sonali Shetty at the Pooja Multispeciality Dental Clinic. If you care to read, I am happy to share why.

After years of poor experiences with dentists in my neighborhood (Goregaon/Malad) I was recommended to meet Dr. Sonali Shetty by a family physician - Dr. Laddha.

The Pooja Multipspeciality Dental Clinic itself is beautifully located and seems small until you walk in (it has tremendous depth and is two storied). The waiting lounge is clean and comfortable and the staff friendly.

Dr. Sonali Shetty was prompt on time for our appointment. She was kind and charming - a trait that puts at ease most patients (lile me) who dread walking into a dentist's clinic.

After a thorough assessment Dr. Sonali Shetty articulated clearly the problems she identified and the work that needs to be done. She addressed all my queries with patience, thereby gaining my confidence.

I was scheduled for multiple root canals, teeth fillings and a clean up. The entirety of the work was spaced across 4 appointments with pointed goals for each.

Each session was conducted in their spacious upper floor dental operatory. I have to admit I had never seen a prettier operatory before. It was clean, smelled great, had a large window view of the street, coloured walls and calming music. I cannot emphasize enough how this put me at ease.

During the sessions Dr. Sonali constantly checked in with me to see if i was comfortable or in any pain. She communicated what she was working on clealry and kept me updated on our progress. Again the signature of a great doctor.

The wonderful experience of my first session alone became the reason why I started to gleefully look forward to the next. And each time hop, skip and strut into the patients chair like a happy little school boy - confident that my dental well being was in the hands of a skilled doctor with impeccable patient bed side manner.

One of my favorite movie lines is - Faith must be rewarded. When a patient chooses a doctor they put their faith in them. They hope their medical training combined with their innate skills offer a resolution to the problems plaguing the patient when they first walk in through the door.

I chose Dr. Sonali Shetty. I offered her my faith with the same hope. And she rewarded it by giving me a lost piece of me back. For years I had stopped smiling openly cause my teeth were broken and ugly. It had impacted my confidence in social settings and deterred me from even mustering the courage to ask a girl out on a date.

But after my last session, when she held up that mirror I got to see my old self again. The one that expressed the joy he felt in the little things by offering a toothy smile. I walked back home that day smiling at every stranger that looked at me. I even smiled at the stray animals. I was HAPPY. I was ME.

Shortly afterwards, I asked a girl out. I got to experience my first kiss in years. My dating life sprung back to life. I have always been well mannered and witty. But I finally got my confidence back. And in the words of my generation - I got my mojo back. In the 2 years since, I have had the privilege of going on many dates . And while each date had some specific reason why they swiped right on my dating profile - ALL of them LOVED my smile.

And for that I am and shall forever be grateful to Dr. Sonali Shetty.

I hope that YOU - the reader and prospective patient - chooose her and the clinic herein and offer them your faith just as I did. I am confident your faith shall be rewarded.

And while you choose to visit the clinic for medical reasons, I also hope you take the time to learn the stories of the many people who work there. One in particular is Pooja. She is the first person you see when you walk in and the last person you see when you walk out. And when you are in the patients chair she is standing right by your side. Omnipresent. A true brand custodian. One who deserves as much credit as the many      doctors who have graced the operatory.

Like i said, I recommend THEM enthusiastically. Now you know why.
